body:
Production build (`cubiqo.ai`) fails because Next.js 16 defaults to Turbopack, but `next.config.js` had a `webpack` config block (even a no-op) with no `turbopack` config ΓÇö fatal error. Secondary failures from uninstalled optional packages (`dockerode`, `ioredis`, `@xterm/*`) that were imported but never added to `package.json`.

### `next.config.js`
- Removed deprecated/unsupported options: `eslint`, `webpack`, `experimental.forceSwcTransforms`
- Added `turbopack.resolveAlias` to stub out uninstalled optional packages
- Added `serverExternalPackages` for server-only optional deps

```js
turbopack: {
  resolveAlias: {
    'dockerode': './src/lib/stubs/optional-package.ts',
    'ioredis': './src/lib/stubs/optional-package.ts',
    '@xterm/xterm': './src/lib/stubs/optional-package.ts',
    '@xterm/addon-fit': './src/lib/stubs/optional-package.ts',
  },
},
```

### Module import resilience
- **`redis.ts`** ΓÇö top-level `import` ΓåÆ dynamic `require()` with try/catch, returns `null` gracefully (existing fallback behavior preserved)
- **`docker-manager.ts`** ΓÇö same pattern, with error logging when dockerode unavailable
- **`TerminalPanel.tsx`** ΓÇö top-level `import` ΓåÆ dynamic `import()` in `useEffect`, renders fallback UI on failure
